declarations.documentation:
One persona LAYER — the unit the caller supplies, and the whole DATA surface of this package. A
layer is a named, capped, seeded slice of a persona: @name@ is its store key and the identifier
`refine` targets, @label@ is the `[label]` header its assembled section wears, @cap@ is the HARD
character ceiling `refine` enforces, @seed@ is the in-code default body shown until a refinement is
stored, @roles@ is the set of role names that SEE this layer, and @hard_lines@ is an uneditable
prefix prepended above the refinable body at every assembly (blank for a layer with none).
declarations.name: layer

parameters.documentation: The layer's store key AND the identifier `refine` targets, e.g. "identity".

declarations.documentation:
The facility's one subdirectory under the calling workspace — the constant every persona read and
write prefixes its store key with. WHERE this lands is the calling workspace's decision (a desk's
private corner, or a shared subtree a proxy opened above the desks): the package hard-codes the
subdirectory NAME, never the full location.
declarations.name: path

declarations.documentation:
Render one stored layer value as text: a plain string as itself, anything else as its JSON — TOTAL,
so a malformed stored value degrades rather than throwing into an every-turn assembly.
declarations.name: render_value

declarations.documentation:
The LIVE body of one layer: its stored value once a refinement exists (the store wins), its
in-code @seed@ until then. Read TOTAL — a missing entry falls back to the seed, a malformed one
renders as its JSON. The caller must already stand inside the facility scope (`assemble` opens it
once around the whole read).
declarations.name: live_body

declarations.checkedType: agent(layers: array[layer], role: string) -> string with delete | get | list | set
declarations.documentation:
Assemble one ROLE's persona note: for each layer the role SEES (in the given order), render its
`[label]` section — hard lines above the stored-or-seed body — then join the sections with a blank
line, reading every layer fresh from the store under the facility scope. A layer the role does not
see is skipped, so ONE ordered @layers@ list drives every role's note, and a role that sees nothing
assembles to the empty string. Inject the result per turn: because it reads fresh, a refinement is
live on the very next turn and a compaction can never eat a persona.
declarations.name: assemble

declarations.checkedType: agent(layers: array[layer], name: string, text: string) -> string with delete | get | list | set
declarations.documentation:
Refine one layer — the anti-creep write, and the model-facing tool result. Look @name@ up among
@layers@: an unknown name answers a corrective note listing the layers (never a crash — the name is
model-supplied); a @text@ over the layer's cap is REJECTED with the cap and the overshoot, so the
model compresses instead of accumulating (the cap is the mechanism; it does not move); a text within
cap OVERWRITES the whole layer body under the facility scope and confirms. The hard lines are not
stored and not touched — they ride above the body at assembly, so a refine can retune a layer but
never sand off its hard lines. A whole-key overwrite is last-write-wins and needs no critical
section; WHERE it lands is the caller's scope plus this facility's own subdirectory.
declarations.name: refine
